### Jacob Outwits Laban
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jacob-outwits-laban
Passage: Genesis 30:43
Points:
- Scripture often records what biblical figures did without necessarily endorsing their specific actions or ideas.
- Jacob's reliance on peeled branches reflected popular ancient breeding folklore rather than scientific reality.
- The dramatic multiplication of Jacob's flocks came through divine providence rather than human manipulation.
- When the Lord resolves to bless His people, no opponent and no human error can prevent it.
- Believers can take comfort knowing Christ's sovereign grace triumphs over opposition and human weakness.

### A Blessing For Others
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-nov-13-2010-11640851.html
Passage: Genesis 30:27-30
Points:
- Laban openly acknowledged that his household prospered because the Lord blessed Jacob.
- The presence of a believer should naturally bring peace, stability, and blessings to surrounding people.
- Unbelievers may initially overlook spiritual realities, but the visible fruit of a godly life eventually testifies to God.
- Even if one is the only Christian in a family or workplace, faithful prayer provides spiritual covering.
- Believers carry the Holy Spirit's presence wherever they go and must faithfully reflect God's goodness.
